data.narrative: Practiced the refine-vs-restart discipline on real team-feature iterations: tracked structural and surface quality per round, executed one justified restart with an interface-contract prompt, and pinned regression detection with a live schema contract check instead of re-reviewing polluted context.

dimension_scores.observation: The restart prompt embedded the upstream task's actual output verbatim (created_by, team_members join table, role values, permission rule, 409/404 codes) plus a preventative rule -- significantly better than the original plan-based prompt.
dimension_scores.evidence: interface-contract-m2.md embeds the exact schema and permission contract; prompt evolution documented from plan-assumptions to contract-verbatim.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized the spiral via trajectory data, then made detection concrete with a live schema-contract probe (created_by intact, owner not in team_members, roles, constraints) -- not by re-reading accumulated context.

dimension_scores.observation: Used 1 restart + 3 refinements across the whole feature; the only structural conflict was caught on round 1 and restarted immediately rather than spiraling; all later rounds were single-refinement or zero-iteration.

dimension_scores.observation: Correctly classified the M2 schema conflict as structural (restart) and the M3 redact bug as surface (single edit), and shipped only after all verification scenarios re-ran green.

dimension_scores.observation: Shipped output is production-ready: no known regressions, automated regression nets (92 tests + 9-case IDOR probe + contract check) in place for any future round.
